answer.evidence: The object is a tall, thin standing signboard, not a box. The only possible top is a 2-row lighter strip at rows 1-2 (L=130), followed by a slightly darker header band at rows 3-4 (L=91) and a dark line at row 5. The strip is the same width as the body (14px) and does not widen or narrow, so it is not an ellipse. It is a rim, not a real receding top. Rows 6-26 are a flat vertical panel with white lettering, and rows 27-30 are a base strip. The silhouette is a constant 14px wide from rows 1-30. No side face and no visible contents. This reads as a front elevation.
